new='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque, Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]; edge=False
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x)); edge |= y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if not edge:
                fill=2 if len(cells)%2==0 else 7
                for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''; open(f,'w').write(new); spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',f); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); o=m.transform(g); print(o)
